content.title: NDSN Q3 Deep Dive: Margin Expansion Offsets Flat Sales, Cautious Outlook for Year-End
content.summary: Manufacturing company Nordson (NASDAQ:NDSN) fell short of the markets revenue expectations in Q3 CY2025, with sales flat year on year at $751.8 million. Next quarter’s revenue guidance of $650 million underwhelmed, coming in 0.9% below analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $3.03 per share was 3.4% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
